description: Blacksmith runner support. Blacksmith's image ships `/etc/profile.d/blacksmith.sh`. For the `runner` user, the file exports `HOME` from `/etc/passwd` in each login shell. `cli-first-install-smoke.sh` and `remote-sandbox-suite.test.ts` set `HOME` to a temporary directory and start `bash -lc`, so `agro` is not on `PATH` (runs 40165681253 and 40165682797, diagnostic run 40166221855). GitHub-hosted runners have no such file. Real users are not affected, because their `HOME` matches `/etc/passwd`.

userStories.title: Keep the job HOME in login shells on Blacksmith runners
userStories.description: As the operator, I want agro CI to pass on Blacksmith runners. The CLI install smokes then run on the Blacksmith primary, and GitHub-hosted runners stay the fallback.
acceptanceCriteria: The `ci` job in `.github/workflows/ci-harness.yml` and the `sandbox-boot-guard` job in `.github/workflows/sandbox-boot-guard.yml` each have a step named `Keep the job HOME in login shells`. The step runs before the first step that runs the CLI install smoke.

When `/etc/profile.d/blacksmith.sh` exists, the step disables its `export HOME="$RUNNER_HOME"` line, then fails when the line is still active. When the file does not exist, the step exits 0 and changes nothing.
`.agro/scripts/__tests__/ci-workflow-contract.test.ts` asserts the step in both jobs and the parity runner expression.
